title: kehti hai sakina
body:
(Kehti hai sakina ×4)
(Alatash ki sada e deti hai)
(Kehti hai sakina×2)
(1) Tab tum gaye dariya par,
Wapas nahi aye
pyasa hai mera asghar(a.s)
pyase hai wo pyaree
intezar jo karti ho aao na chacha jaan
(Kehti hai sakina ×4)
(2) kehti thi phuphi meri,
ayenge chacha jaan
deti thi dilasa mujhe,
meri phuphi amma
sabr karo aye jaan ayenge chacha jaan
(Kehti hai sakina ×4)
(3) baba nazar ane lage,
aap ka alam bhi
tab bhi meri ek aas,
ammu nahi tooti
afsous hai ammu tum bhi tho na aye na
(Kehti hai sakina ×4)
(4) ammu tumhare baad,
Kya kya na wo guzre
Shamiyou ne akaar,
Gauhar mere chinee
Kitna muje wo dard pohoncha tha chacha jaan
(Kehti hai sakina ×4)
(5) ammu hame bahooth
phirwaya gaya tha,
yaad ata hai manzar
tadpayagaya tha
mai tumko bolati rahi tum bhi tho na aye na
(Kehti hai sakina ×4)
(6) Syed Raza hussain,
Zehra ke azadar
Rizvi jo tumne likha,
Shahzadi ka ye bain
bas khatm kar nisaar ye ghum ye dastaan
(kehti hai sakina-4)
alatash ki sadae (deti hai sakina-2)
